verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships a built-in AssistantAgent that uses an LLM and tools, and docs show a direct code example of delegating a task via `agent.run(task=...)`, plus AutoGen Studio offers a UI to run and interact with such agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of the built-in AssistantAgent delegation workflow (community evidence is about general framework quality, not this specific feature).
